caption: The drawing depicts a single, hollow, oval-shaped vessel with a circular opening at the top. The vessel features a continuous, ring-like body that is wide and rounded, with the central space left open. The opening at the top is cylindrical and protrudes slightly upward from the ring. The surface of the vessel is decorated with a mottled pattern consisting primarily of earthy brown, green, and hints of yellow colors, distributed unevenly across the surface. The background is plain and off-white, with a thin rectangular border framing the composition. There is a small handwritten annotation and a signature near the lower right edge of the image.
title: Ring Bottle
